title: Final Energy Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The energy required to remove the charges must be correctly calculated as W = -Q^2 ln(2)/(4πε₀x).

title: Force on Charges
description: Important Criteria: The forces on both charges must be identified as zero due to symmetry.

title: Force on Plates
description: Important Criteria: The forces on each plate must be derived correctly, showing the dependence on Q and ε₀.

title: Induced Charge Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The total induced charge on each plate must be correctly identified as -Q/2 and Q/2.

title: Induced Charge After Removal
description: Important Criteria: The induced charge on the plates after removing -Q must be calculated correctly as -3Q/4 and -Q/4.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common errors include incorrect signs in the energy or induced charge calculations.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: All calculations should maintain consistent units throughout the problem.

title: Method of Images
description: Optional Criteria: The use of the method of images should be clearly justified in the solution.
